/schools/{schoolId}.description: Publicly readable directory of Kanpur MDM schools; writable by Super Admin or active TAPF Staff Members.

/routes/{routeId}.description: Publicly readable delivery route definitions; writable by Super Admin or active TAPF Staff Members.

/staff_members/{memberId}.description: TAPF office staff accounts; writable exclusively by Super Admin shivamvk1090@gmail.com.

/audit_logs/{logId}.description: Audit log recording school, route, staff, and verification settings modifications.

/app_settings/verification_status.description: Single non-PII toggle and global revocation timestamp controlling organization email verification.

/app_settings/org_verification_policy.description: Private backend verification policy (allowed domains & emails); readable and writable exclusively by Super Admin.

/access_logs/{logId}.description: Organization email access log; creates are backend-verified via Firestore rules, reads & revocation updates strictly restricted to Super Admin.

/revoked_sessions/{logId}.description: Zero-PII single-session revocation tombstones; targeted get by exact ID allows clients to detect immediate revocation without exposing emails.
